answers.how: The bike moves about 224 pixels/s, giving 40.6 pixels/m. The wheel diameter is about 29 pixels: 29/40.6 ≈ 0.71 m.
At the bike's crossing position, the road spans approximately 374 pixels. Using 40.6 pixels/m gives 374/40.6 ≈ 9.2 m.
The bike's end-to-end length is approximately 73 pixels. Using 40.6 pixels/m gives 73/40.6 ≈ 1.79 m.
